exercises.instructionUz: Böş joylarga am, is yoki are sözlarini qöying.
exercises.explanationUz: I bilan am, yagona şaxs va narsa bilan is, you/we/they hamda köplik bilan are işlatiladi.
exercises.text: I ___ a student. She ___ a teacher. They ___ my friends. The book ___ on the desk.

exercises.instructionUz: Uşbu sözlardan töğri tartibda gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz: Ingliz tilida tartib şunday: ega + to be + qolgan qismi. She is my teacher.
Ism söraş uçun “What is your name?” deyiladi.
exercises.question: Which question asks about a name?
Which sentences are correct?
exercises.explanationUz: I + am, he / she / it + is, we / you / they + are. “She are” va “We is” — xato.

exercises.instructionUz: Har söz bilan “is” yoki “are” işlatiladi? Saralang.
exercises.explanationUz: Bir kişi yoki narsa (he, she, it, Samir) → is; we, you, they va ikki kişi (Samir and Bekzod) → are. I bilan esa faqat am.

exercises.question: Samir yangi dösti bilan tanişmoqda.
items: Hi! My name is Bekzod. And you?
I am Samir. How old are you?
itemsShuffled: I am Samir. How old are you?
Hi! My name is Bekzod. And you?
exercises.explanationUz: Avval salom va ism söraladi, keyin javob beriladi, söng yoş söraladi va javob keladi.
Salom! Men Samirman va men ön bir yoşdaman. — Hello! I am Samir and I am eleven.
exercises.source: Salom! Men Samirman va men ön bir yoşdaman.
accepted: Hello! I am Samir and I am eleven.

exercises.explanationUz: Uning ismi Nurina. U bizning ingliz tili öqituvçimiz. — Her name is Nurina. She is our English teacher.

exercises.instructionUz: Uçta variant xato, ulardan faqat bittasi grammatik jihatdan töğri. Öşa gapni belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz: He — uçinçi şaxs yagona, şuning uçun is kerak: He is my brother.
exercises.question: Which sentence is correct?

exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni inkor şakliga aylantiring va böş joylarni töldiring.
exercises.explanationUz: Inkor uçun to be dan keyin not qöyiladi: am not, is not (isn’t), are not (aren’t).
exercises.text: I ___ late. We ___ in Class Eight.

exercises.instructionUz: Sözlarni tartiblab, yoş haqidagi söroq gap hosil qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: Yoş söraş uçun: How old + are + you? Söroqda are egadan oldin çiqadi.

exercises.instructionUz: Har böşliq uçun to be fe’lining töğri şaklini tanlang.
exercises.text: My name ___ Samir. I ___ eleven years old. Nurina and Bekzod ___ my friends.
exercises.explanationUz: My name — u (it) → is; I → am; Nurina and Bekzod — ular (they) → are.

exercises.instructionUz: Böş joylarga have got yoki has got ni töğri şaklda joylang.
exercises.explanationUz: I / you / we / they — have got; he / she / it — has got.

exercises.instructionUz: Kim bilan “have got”, kim bilan “has got” işlatiladi? Saralang.
exercises.explanationUz: Bir kişi (he / she / ism) → has got; I, we, you, they va köplik → have got.

exercises.instructionUz: Bu maşqda egalik olmoşlari kerak: my, your, his, her, our yoki their.
exercises.explanationUz: Onaga tegişli narsa — her, otaga — his, bizga — our, öquvçilarga — their.

exercises.text: I ___ a student. She ___ a teacher. They ___ my friends. The book ___ on the desk.
exercises.explanationUz: I bilan am, yagona şaxs va narsa bilan is, you/we/they hamda köplik bilan are işlatiladi.

exercises.text: I ___ late. We ___ in Class Eight.
exercises.explanationUz: Inkor uçun to be dan keyin not qöyiladi: am not, is not (isn’t), are not (aren’t).

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “My name is Aziza and I am twelve.”
exercises.explanationUz: “My name is ...” — “Mening ismim ...”. To be fe’li özbekçada qöşimça bilan ifodalanadi.
“Bu mening kitobim” = This is my book. Bu yerda is albatta kerak.

exercises.text: My name ___ Samir. I ___ eleven years old. Nurina and Bekzod ___ my friends.
exercises.explanationUz: My name — u (it) → is; I → am; Nurina and Bekzod — ular (they) → are.

exercises.text: I ___ a little brother. My sister ___ long hair. We ___ two cats.
exercises.explanationUz: I / you / we / they — have got; he / she / it — has got.

exercises.text: This is ___ mother and father (bizning). Rustam has a bike. ___ bike is blue. That girl is kind. ___ name is Aziza.
exercises.explanationUz: Onaga tegişli narsa — her, otaga — his, bizga — our, öquvçilarga — their.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “My grandmother's garden is small and she has got two cats.”
exercises.explanationUz: 'My grandmother's garden' — bibimning boği, she has got — uning ... bor.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “U yoş va uning uzun soçi bor.”
exercises.explanationUz: Yoş — to be bilan, soç — has got bilan: She is young and she has got long hair.

exercises.text: Sanjar ___ got a big red bag. ___ name is Sanjar. My parents ___ got a small flat.
exercises.explanationUz: Sanjar (he) → has got; öğil bolaning ismi → His name; my parents (they) → have got.

exercises.text: I ___ to school every day (go). My brother ___ his homework at five (do). She ___ TV in the evening (watch).
exercises.explanationUz: He / she / it bilan fe’lga -s qöşiladi: goes, does, watches.

exercises.text: My father ___ work on Sunday. I ___ watch TV in the morning.
exercises.explanationUz: I / you / we / they — don’t; he / she / it — doesn’t.

exercises.question: I get up ___ half past six.
accepted: at
exercises.explanationUz: Soat bilan at: at half past six. Kun bilan on, kunduz qismi bilan in.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “She does her homework in the evening.”
exercises.explanationUz: “She does her homework” — u uy vazifasini qiladi; “in the evening” — keçqurun.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “Biz odatda soat yettida keçki ovqat qilamiz.”
exercises.explanationUz: Keçki ovqat — have dinner; soat yettida — at seven o’clock.

exercises.text: Aziza ___ up at half past six. She ___ hot tea for breakfast. Her friends ___ to school with her.
exercises.explanationUz: Aziza / she → wakes, drinks (-s bilan); her friends (they) → walk (-s siz).

exercises.text: ___ a big sofa in our living room. ___ four chairs in the kitchen. ___ a lamp on the desk. ___ two cats under the table.
exercises.explanationUz: Bitta narsa — There is; ikki yoki köp narsa — There are.

exercises.question: The cat sleeps ___ the bed.
accepted: under
exercises.explanationUz: Muşuk karavotning ostida — under (“ostida”).

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “There are three windows in my room.”
exercises.explanationUz: There are three windows — “uçta deraza bor”; in my room — “mening xonamda”.
Joy sözi ingliz tilida fe’ldan keyin keladi: are under the table.

exercises.text: The shoes are ___ the door. The cup is ___ the table. My mother is ___ the kitchen. The cat sleeps ___ the chair.
exercises.explanationUz: next to — yonida, on — ustida, in — içida, under — ostida.

exercises.text: My school bag is ___ the chair. The kitchen is ___ to the bathroom. A picture of my family is ___ the wall.
exercises.explanationUz: under — ostida; next to — yonida; on the wall — devorda.

exercises.text: We have ___ bread for breakfast. There isn’t ___ milk in the fridge. Are there ___ eggs at home? I want ___ tea with sugar.
exercises.explanationUz: Tasdiq gap — some; inkor va söroq gap — any.

exercises.question: How ___ eggs do we need for the cake?
accepted: many
exercises.explanationUz: “eggs” sanaladigan köplik, şuning uçun how many.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “There isn’t any milk in the fridge.”
exercises.explanationUz: isn’t any — “yöq”; in the fridge — “muzlatgiçda”.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “Men ovqat pişirişni yoqtiraman.”
exercises.explanationUz: yoqtiraman = like, pişiriş = cooking (like’den keyin -ing).

exercises.text: I ate ___ banana. Are there ___ tomatoes in the salad? There isn’t ___ cheese at home. We need ___ rice for lunch.
exercises.explanationUz: banana undoş ovoz bilan boşlanadi — undan oldin a; söroqda any; inkorda any; tasdiqgapda some.

exercises.text: There isn’t ___ milk in the fridge. We buy ___ meat at the market. Are there ___ apples in the bag?
exercises.explanationUz: Inkor va söroq gapda — any; tasdiq gapda — some.

exercises.text: I ___ swim, but I ___ dance. My brother ___ play football very well. ___ you ride a bike?
exercises.explanationUz: Ma’no ijobiy bölsa — can, qila olmaslik bölsa — can’t.

exercises.question: My cousin ___ play the guitar.
accepted: can
exercises.explanationUz: “can”dan keyin fe’l öz şaklida: can play.

exercises.text: I ___ going to ride a bike. He ___ going to play basketball. We ___ going to the park. ___ you going to watch a film?
exercises.explanationUz: I — am; u (he) — is; we — are; söroqda are.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “She isn’t going to play basketball this weekend.”
exercises.explanationUz: isn’t going to — “bormoqçi emas”; this weekend — “şu hafta oxirida”.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “Men yaxşi suza olaman.”
exercises.explanationUz: “qila olaman” = I can + fe’l; “yaxşi” (well) — qöşimça ma’noni yetkazadi.

exercises.text: Sardor ___ play football very well. His sister ___ swim. On Saturday Sardor and Farrukh ___ going to watch a film.
exercises.explanationUz: Sardor futbolni yaxşi öynay oladi (can); singlisi suza olmaydi (can’t); ikki kişi (they) → are going to.

exercises.text: Yesterday ___ Saturday. I ___ at the bus stop. My friends ___ on the metro. The ticket ___ cheap.
exercises.explanationUz: I / he / she / it — was; we / you / they — were.

exercises.question: My brother and I ___ at the airport yesterday.
accepted: were
exercises.explanationUz: “My brother and I” — ikki kişi (they), şuning uçun were.

exercises.text: The bus stop is ___ the gate. The airport is not ___ — it is near. Go ___ ahead and turn ___ at the crossing.
exercises.explanationUz: next to — yonida; far — uzoq; straight ahead — töğri; turn left — çapga.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “Excuse me, how do I get to the airport?”
exercises.explanationUz: “how do I get to” — “... qanday boraman”.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “Keça men uyda edim.”
exercises.explanationUz: keça — yesterday, men — I, edim — was.

exercises.text: Go straight ahead and turn ___ at the crossing. The museum is ___ to the blue gate. Last weekend we ___ in Samarkand.
exercises.explanationUz: Matnda: “turn left at the crossing”, “next to the blue gate”; we → were.

exercises.question: How old is Samir?
accepted: Eleven
exercises.explanationUz: Matnda: “I am eleven years old.” (Bekzod ön ikki yoşda, uni aralaştirmang.)

exercises.text: Samir says: My ___ is Samir. There are ___ desks in his classroom. His new ___ is Bekzod.
exercises.explanationUz: Javoblar: name / twenty / friend — barçasi matnda sözma-söz bor.

exercises.question: How many people are there in Dilnoza’s family?
accepted: Five
exercises.explanationUz: “there are five people in it — my mother, my father, my little brother, my grandmother and me.”

exercises.text: Dilnoza’s mother is ___ and she has long ___ hair. Sanjar has got a big ___ bag.
exercises.explanationUz: Javoblar: tall, black, red — uçala söz ham matnda bor.

exercises.question: What time does school start?
accepted: At eight o’clock
exercises.explanationUz: Ikkinçi paragrafda: “School starts at eight o’clock.”

exercises.question: Which subject does Aziza like most?
accepted: English
exercises.explanationUz: “My favourite subject is English.”

exercises.text: Aziza wakes up at ___ past six. She is never ___ at school. In the afternoon she does her ___.
exercises.explanationUz: Javoblar: half, late, homework — matndagi sözlar.

exercises.question: How many rooms are there in the flat?
accepted: Five
exercises.explanationUz: Birinçi paragraf: “There are five rooms: a living room, two bedrooms, a kitchen and a bathroom.”

exercises.question: Where is the school bag?
accepted: Under the chair
exercises.explanationUz: Ikkinçi paragraf: “my school bag is under the chair”.

exercises.text: There are five rooms in my flat. My school bag is ___ the chair. A picture is ___ the wall. There ___ no computers in our rooms, but there ___ a soft sofa in the living room.
exercises.explanationUz: Matnda “five rooms” deyilgan — are; sumka stul ostida — under; rasm devor ustida — on; “computers” köplik — böş joyga are (söz “There” allaqaçon yozilgan).

exercises.text: We need ___ food for the weekend. There isn’t ___ milk in the fridge. Are there ___ apples in the bag? I like ___ soup.
exercises.explanationUz: Tasdiq gap — some; inkor va söroq — any; like’den keyin — cooking.

exercises.question: What can Sardor do very well?
accepted: Play football
exercises.explanationUz: Birinçi paragraf: “I can play football very well.”

exercises.text: Sardor ___ ride a bike for two hours. His sister can’t ___. On Sunday he ___ going to ride bikes in the hills with his father.
exercises.explanationUz: Qobiliyat — can / can’t; reja — am going to.

exercises.question: How does the writer go to school every day?
accepted: By bus
exercises.explanationUz: Birinçi paragraf: “I go to school by bus every day.”

exercises.question: How long were they on the train?
accepted: Three hours
exercises.explanationUz: Ikkinçi paragraf: “We were on a big train for three hours”.

exercises.text: Yesterday ___ Saturday. My family and I ___ at the railway station. To get to the museum, go straight ahead and turn ___ at the crossing.
exercises.explanationUz: “Yesterday was ...”, “we were ...”, yölda esa “turn left” deyiladi.

exercises.question: Who is Nurina?
accepted: The English teacher
exercises.explanationUz: Boşida u özini “I am your English teacher” deb taniştiradi.

exercises.question: How old is Bekzod?
accepted: Twelve
exercises.explanationUz: Bekzod: “I am twelve years old.”

exercises.text: Samir says: Hello, my ___ is Samir. I am ___.
exercises.explanationUz: Samir şunday deydi: my name is Samir. I am eleven.

exercises.question: How old is Nilufar?
accepted: Fifteen
exercises.explanationUz: Nilufar haqida: “She is fifteen and she is tall like my father.”

exercises.text: Sardor says: My father is ___ and he has got short ___ hair.
exercises.explanationUz: “My father is tall and he has got short black hair.”

exercises.question: What time does school start for Bekzod?
accepted: At eight o’clock
exercises.explanationUz: “School starts at eight o’clock and we have six lessons.”

exercises.text: Bekzod says: I wake up at ___ thirty in the morning and I get up ___.
exercises.explanationUz: Bekzod şunday deydi: “I wake up at six thirty … and I get up fast.”

exercises.question: Where do the girls talk?
accepted: At Aziza’s home
exercises.explanationUz: Boşida Aziza “Welcome to my home. Come in” deydi — suhbat undining uyida.

exercises.question: Where is the TV?
accepted: Under the picture
exercises.explanationUz: Transkript: “The TV is next to the window, under the picture.”

exercises.text: In the living room the TV is next to the ___. Then the girls go to the ___. Boni the cat is ___ the bed. Tomorrow the girls want to do ___ together.
exercises.explanationUz: Avval mehmonxona, keyin oşxona körsatiladi; televizor deraza yonida; muşuk karavot ostida; ertaga uy vazifasi qilişadi.

exercises.question: What food is already on the table?
accepted: Bread and eggs
exercises.explanationUz: Ona: “there is some bread on the table. There are two eggs too.” — javob non va tuxum. Pişloq umuman yöq, asal stol ustidagi yaşil piyolada, guruç qutida, banan esa eşik yonidagi sumkada.

exercises.text: For breakfast there is bread and there are two ___. There isn’t any ___ in the fridge. Sanjar wants a ___ and some water. He can make ___ and eggs for lunch.
exercises.explanationUz: Non va tuxum bor; pişloq yöq; Sanjar banan va suv söraydi; u tuşlikka guruç va tuxum pişira oladi.

exercises.text: On Saturday the boys are going to play ___ in the park. Sardor can bring water and some ___. Farrukh wants his ___ in the park. On Sunday Sardor is going to ___ a bike with his father.
exercises.explanationUz: Futbol — Şanba; Sardor suv va olma olib keladi; Farrukh gitara olib kelişini söraydi; Sardor Yakşanba velosipedda boradi.

exercises.question: Where does the tourist want to go?
accepted: To the airport
exercises.explanationUz: Sayyoh boşidayoq aeroportga qanday borişini söraydi.

exercises.question: How can the tourist go to the station?
accepted: By metro
exercises.explanationUz: “You can take the metro to the station” va “the metro is fast and clean, so take it”.

exercises.text: The tourist must turn ___ at the crossing. The metro finishes at ___ o’clock. Yesterday the tourist ___ on a bus for three hours. A ticket can be bought at the small ___ next to the gate.
exercises.explanationUz: Çorrahada çapga buriladi; metro soat ön birda (eleven) tugaydi; keça sayyoh avtobusda edi; bilet kiçkina deraçadan olinadi.

exercises.question: Which word means "sinf xonasi"?
accepted: classroom
exercises.explanationUz: “sinf xonasi” = classroom.

exercises.text: Ten and five is ___. Nine and nine is ___.
exercises.explanationUz: 10 + 5 = 15 (fifteen), 9 + 9 = 18 (eighteen).

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “Goodbye, see you tomorrow!”
exercises.explanationUz: Goodbye — xayr, körişgunça.

exercises.question: These pencils ___ mine.
accepted: are
exercises.explanationUz: Köplikdagi “these pencils” bilan are işlatiladi.

exercises.question: What time do the students come back to class?
accepted: At eight o’clock
exercises.explanationUz: Öqituvçi: See you at eight o’clock.

exercises.question: What has Sardor’s father got?
accepted: Short black hair
exercises.explanationUz: Sardor: “My father is tall and he has got short black hair.”
‘Otamning velosipedi’ = My father's bike.

exercises.text: My grandfather is not young, he is ___. My brother is not short, he is ___.
exercises.explanationUz: tall — baland böyli, young — yoş, tall uçun opposite — short.

exercises.text: School starts ___ eight o’clock. We have an English lesson ___ Monday. I do my homework ___ the afternoon.
exercises.explanationUz: Soat — at, hafta kuni — on, kunduz qismi — in.

exercises.question: My sister ___ TV in the evening.
accepted: watches
exercises.explanationUz: My sister — uçinçi şaxs yagona: watches.

exercises.question: Where does Aziza have lunch?
accepted: At school
exercises.explanationUz: “We have lunch at twelve o’clock at school.”

exercises.text: We have lessons from ___ to Friday. The weekend days are ___ and ___.
exercises.explanationUz: Biz duşanbadan juma rigaça öqiymiz: Monday. Dam oliş kunlari — Saturday, Sunday.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “U keçqurun soat töqqizda uxlaydi.”
exercises.explanationUz: uxlaşga bormoq = go to bed; “soat töqqizda” = at nine o’clock; “keçqurun” = in the evening.

exercises.question: Which word means "oşxona"?
accepted: kitchen
exercises.explanationUz: “oşxona” = kitchen.

exercises.question: The pillow is ___ the bed.
accepted: on
exercises.explanationUz: Yostiq karavot ustida — on (“ustida”).

exercises.question: ___ three lamps in the shop.
accepted: There are
exercises.explanationUz: “three lamps” köplik, şuning uçun There are.

exercises.text: There ___ one window in my room. There ___ two doors. Two and one is ___.
exercises.explanationUz: Bitta deraza — is; “two doors” — are; “two doors” yozilişi "two".

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “Mehmonxonada katta divan bor.”
exercises.explanationUz: “Mehmonxonada katta divan bor” = There is a big sofa in the living room.

exercises.question: Which word means "çanqagan"?
accepted: thirsty
exercises.explanationUz: thirsty — çanqagan; hungry — oç.

exercises.question: Are there ___ bananas in the bag?
accepted: any
exercises.explanationUz: Söroq gapda any işlatiladi.

exercises.text: My father enjoys ___ dinner. There is ___ bread on the table. There isn’t ___ tea in the cup.
exercises.explanationUz: like’den keyin cooking; tasdiqda some; inkorda any.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “Oşxonada biroz non bor.”
exercises.explanationUz: “Oşxonada biroz non bor” = There is some bread in the kitchen.

exercises.question: Which word means "kinoteatr"?
accepted: cinema
exercises.explanationUz: cinema — kinoteatr.

exercises.question: My sister can ___ three English songs.
accepted: sing
exercises.explanationUz: “can”dan keyin fe’l öz şaklida — sing.

exercises.text: I ___ dance, but I ___ swim. On Sunday I ___ going to ride a bike.
exercises.explanationUz: Iloj bor — can, yöq — can’t; reja — am going to.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “Men ertaga kinoteatrga bormoqçiman.”
exercises.explanationUz: “Men ertaga kinoteatrga bormoqçiman” = I am going to the cinema ...

exercises.question: She ___ a teacher and I ___ her student.
accepted: is / am
exercises.explanationUz: “She” — uçinçi şaxs yagona, şuning uçun is.

exercises.question: My uncle’s daughter is my ___.
accepted: cousin
exercises.explanationUz: Amaki yoki toqaning qizi/öğli ingliz tilida “cousin” deyiladi.

exercises.text: Every morning I ___ up at half past six. Then I ___ breakfast with my family at seven o’clock.
exercises.explanationUz: I bilan get / have işlatiladi — present simple, şaxsga -s qöşilmaydi.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “He isn’t thirsty, and he doesn’t want any water.”
exercises.explanationUz: He isn’t thirsty — “u çanqagan emas”; inkor gapda any keladi — “suv ham xohlamaydi”.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “Çapga buriling va töğri boring.”
exercises.explanationUz: Çapga buriling = Turn left; töğri boring = go straight ahead.

exercises.explanationUz: piknik, tabiat qöynida ovqatlaniş — picnic.

exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe’llarni Past Simple şaklida yozing.
exercises.explanationUz: Töğri fe’llarga -ed qöşiladi: visit → visited, cook → cooked, watch → watched, play → played.
exercises.text: Last Saturday I ___ (visit) my aunt. She ___ (cook) plov. In the evening we ___ (watch) a film and my cousins ___ (play) chess.

exercises.explanationUz: Undoş + y bilan tugagan fe’lda y → i böladi: study → studied.
exercises.question: What is the past form of “study”?

exercises.explanationUz: Inkorda did not (didn’t) dan keyin fe’l -ed siz keladi: didn’t watch, didn’t clean.
exercises.text: I ___ TV yesterday. My brother ___ his room on Sunday.

exercises.instructionUz: Grammatik jihatdan töğri söroq gapni belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz: Söroqda did işlatiladi va asosiy fe’l boşlanğiç şaklda qoladi: Did you visit …?
exercises.question: Which question is correct?

exercises.instructionUz: Sözlardan töğri tartibda söroq gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz: Tartib: Wh-söz + did + ega + fe’l + qolgan qism: Where did you go last weekend?

exercises.instructionUz: Inglizça gapni özbek tiliga tarjima qiling.

accepted: Ötgan yakşanba film bizga yoqmadi
Ötgan yakşanba biz filmdan zavqlanmadik

Ötgan yakşanbada film bizga yoqmadi

accepted: Last weekend we visited our grandparents in Bukhara.

exercises.text: Last Saturday I ___ (visit) my aunt. She ___ (cook) plov. In the evening we ___ (watch) a film and my cousins ___ (play) chess.
exercises.explanationUz: Töğri fe’llarga -ed qöşiladi: visit → visited, cook → cooked, watch → watched, play → played.

exercises.question: What is the past form of “study”?
accepted: studied
exercises.explanationUz: Undoş + y bilan tugagan fe’lda y → i böladi: study → studied.

exercises.text: I ___ TV yesterday. My brother ___ his room on Sunday.
exercises.explanationUz: Inkorda did not (didn’t) dan keyin fe’l -ed siz keladi: didn’t watch, didn’t clean.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “Men uç kun oldin buvimnikiga bordim.”
exercises.explanationUz: “Uç kun oldin” = three days ago — ago vaqtdan keyin keladi. Fe’l Past Simple’da: visited.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “We didn’t enjoy the film last Sunday.”
exercises.explanationUz: “Didn’t enjoy” — inkor: “yoqmadi / zavqlanmadi”. Last Sunday = ötgan yakşanba.

exercises.question: I started this course two weeks ___.
accepted: ago
exercises.explanationUz: “Ago” vaqtdan keyin keladi: two weeks ago. “Last” esa vaqtdan oldin: last week.

exercises.text: Yesterday I ___ my grandmother. We ___ watch TV. ___ you call her too?

exercises.text: Yesterday we ___ (go) to the zoo. We ___ (see) a big lion. We ___ (eat) ice cream and my uncle ___ (give) me a balloon.
exercises.explanationUz: go → went, see → saw, eat → ate, give → gave — bu şakllar yod olinadi.

exercises.text: When I ___ six, my sister ___ ten. We ___ always together and our parents ___ very happy.
exercises.explanationUz: I / he / she / it — was; you / we / they — were.

exercises.question: Which question is correct?
accepted: Were you happy?
exercises.explanationUz: Was / were bilan söroqda did işlatilmaydi: Were you happy?

exercises.text: I ___ (not see) the film. He ___ (not take) his umbrella. It ___ (not be) cold.
exercises.explanationUz: Inkorda didn’t + boşlanğiç şakl: didn’t see, didn’t take. To be bilan: wasn’t.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “Bolaligimda biz qişloqda yaşardik.”
exercises.explanationUz: “Bolaligimda” = When I was a child; yaşardik — lived (Past Simple).

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani sözlardan tuzing: “My grandfather made a kite for me.”
exercises.explanationUz: “Made a kite for me” — “menga varrak yasab berdi”.

exercises.text: When I ___ seven, we ___ to Tashkent. ___ you happy there?

drought — qurğoqçilik; irrigation — suğoriş; consequence — oqibat
shrink — kiçraymoq, qisqarmoq; flood — toşqin; suv bosmoq; prevent — oldini olmoq
regret — afsuslanmoq; dust — çang; warning — ogohlantiriş
restore — tiklamoq; crop — ekin; avoidable — oldini oliş mumkin bölgan
journey — safar, yöl yuriş; destination — manzil (borilayotgan joy); luggage — yuk, bagaj
board (a plane, train) — (transportga) çiqmoq; delay — keçikiş; keçiktirmoq; stranger — notaniş odam
hospitality — mehmondöstlik; get lost — adaşib qolmoq; unforgettable — unutilmas
exhausting — holdan toydiradigan; realise — anglab qolmoq, tuşunib yetmoq; eventually — oxir-oqibat
budget — byudjet, xarajatlar rejasi; afford — qurbi yetmoq; savings — jamğarma
loan — qarz, kredit; interest — foiz (bank); debt — qarz
income — daromad; expenses — xarajatlar; impulse buy — öylamay qilingan xarid
scam — firibgarlik; worth (doing) — (qilişga) arziydi; cut down on — kamaytirmoq
volunteer — köngilli; community — jamoa, mahalla ahli; inequality — tengsizlik
pressure — bosim; respect — hurmat; hurmat qilmoq; isolated — yakkalanib qolgan
addicted to — ruju qöygan, … ga qaram; raise awareness — xabardorlikni oşirmoq; donate — xayriya qilmoq, hadya etmoq
fair — adolatli; make a difference — ijobiy ta’sir körsatmoq; generation gap — avlodlar örtasidagi tafovut
goal — maqsad; ambition — intiliş, orzu-maqsad; meet a deadline — muddatda ulgurmoq
accomplish — amalga oşirmoq, bajarib bölmoq; graduate — öqişni tamomlamoq; priority — ustuvor vazifa
long-term — uzoq muddatli; predict — oldindan aytmoq, başorat qilmoq; by then — öşa vaqtgaça
settle down — muqim yaşab qolmoq, oila qurmoq; career path — kasbiy yöl; in ten years’ time — ön yildan keyin
Present Simple → Past Simple: “I am busy” → she was busy.
exercises.question: “I am busy,” Malika said. → Malika said that she ___ busy.

exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni özlaştirma gapga aylantiring (zamonni bir qadam ortga suring).
exercises.explanationUz: will → would; Present Perfect → Past Perfect (had sent).
exercises.text: “We will sign the deal.” → They said they ___ sign the deal. “I have sent the invoice.” → She said she ___ ___ the invoice.

exercises.explanationUz: Özlaştirilgan söroqda darak tartibi: where I worked (did yöq).
exercises.question: “Where do you work?” → He asked me ___.

exercises.instructionUz: Say yoki tell dan töğrisini tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Tell’dan keyin kişi (told us), say’dan keyin kişi kelmaydi.
exercises.question: The manager ___ us that the meeting had been postponed.

exercises.explanationUz: ask + kişi + not to + fe’l: She asked me not to be late.
“Ertaga kela olmayman.” → Dilnoza ertasi kuni kela olmasligini aytdi. — “I can’t come tomorrow.” → Dilnoza said she couldn’t come the next day.
exercises.source: “Ertaga kela olmayman.” → Dilnoza ertasi kuni kela olmasligini aytdi.
accepted: “I can’t come tomorrow.” → Dilnoza said she couldn’t come the next day.

exercises.explanationUz: “Xatimni öqidingizmi?” → Mijoz xatini öqiganimni söradi. — “Have you read my email?” → The client asked if I had read his email.
exercises.source: “Xatimni öqidingizmi?” → Mijoz xatini öqiganimni söradi.
accepted: “Have you read my email?” → The client asked if I had read his email.

exercises.instructionUz: Inglizça gapni özbek tiliga tarjima qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: “Told us not to …” — “bizga … maslikni aytdi”.
exercises.source: The director told us not to discuss the deal with anyone.
accepted: Direktor bizga bitimni heç kim bilan muhokama qilmaslikni aytdi
Direktor bizga bitim haqida heç kim bilan gaplaşmaslikni aytdi
Direktor bizdan bitimni heç kim bilan muhokama qilmaslikni söradi

exercises.explanationUz: tomorrow → the next day (the following day); yesterday → the day before.
exercises.text: “I’ll call you tomorrow.” → He said he would call me the ___ day. “I met him yesterday.” → She said she had met him the day ___.

exercises.instructionUz: Özbekça gapni ingliz tiliga özlaştirma gap bilan tarjima qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: Ha / yöq savol → asked if / whether + darak tartibi + Past Perfect.
exercises.source: Mijoz hisob-fakturani olganimni söradi.
accepted: The client asked if I had received the invoice
The client asked whether I had received the invoice
The customer asked if I had received the invoice
The client asked me if I had received the invoice
The client asked me whether I had received the invoice

exercises.instructionUz: Har böşliq uçun mos şaklni tanlang.
exercises.text: The client ___ me that the goods had arrived. She ___ whether we could send an invoice and asked us ___ the price.
exercises.explanationUz: told + kişi; asked whether; asked us not to + fe’l.
Odam haqida, ega vazifasida — who.
exercises.question: The engineer ___ designed this bridge is only thirty.

exercises.instructionUz: Böş joylarga who, which, whose yoki where ni yozing.
exercises.explanationUz: Egalik — whose; joy — where; narsa — which.
exercises.text: That’s the start-up ___ app helps farmers. This is the lab ___ the batteries are tested. The device, ___ costs fifty dollars, sells well.

exercises.explanationUz: ot + whose + ot + fe’l …: The company whose app won is hiring.

exercises.instructionUz: Inglizça gapni özbek tiliga tarjima qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: Where — “… bölgan / … qilinadigan joy”.
exercises.source: This is the building where the new phones are made.
accepted: Bu yangi telefonlar işlab çiqariladigan bino
Bu — yangi telefonlar yasaladigan bino
Bu yangi telefonlar tayyorlanadigan bino
Yangi telefonlar işlab çiqariladigan bino mana şu

exercises.instructionUz: Izohlovçi ergaş gap töğri yozilgan variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Izohlovçi (vergulli) gapda narsa uçun which keladi; that va who xato, ortiqça it ham kerak emas.
exercises.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: IT Park, that opened in 2019, has grown fast.
IT Park, who opened in 2019, has grown fast.
IT Park, which opened in 2019, has grown fast.
IT Park, which it opened in 2019, has grown fast.

exercises.explanationUz: Ilovani işga tuşirgan kompaniya Toşkentda joylaşgan. — The company that launched the app is based in Tashkent.
exercises.source: Ilovani işga tuşirgan kompaniya Toşkentda joylaşgan.
accepted: The company that launched the app is based in Tashkent.

exercises.explanationUz: Pullari loyihani qutqargan investor Dubayda yaşaydi. — The investor whose money saved the project lives in Dubai.
exercises.source: Pullari loyihani qutqargan investor Dubayda yaşaydi.
accepted: The investor whose money saved the project lives in Dubai.

exercises.instructionUz: Qaysi gapda olmoşni TAŞLAB KETIŞ MUMKIN?
exercises.explanationUz: Olmoş töldiruvçi bölganda (I bought it) taşlanadi: The laptop I bought …
exercises.question: In which sentence can we leave out the relative pronoun?
options: The woman who called you is my boss.
The laptop that I bought is very light.
The app which crashed was new.
Aziz, who lives next door, is a developer.

exercises.instructionUz: Özbekça gapni ingliz tiliga tarjima qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: “… yaratgan dasturçi” — the developer who created …
exercises.source: Bu ilovani yaratgan dasturçi Samarqandda yaşaydi.
accepted: The developer who created this app lives in Samarkand
The developer that created this app lives in Samarkand
The developer who made this app lives in Samarkand
The developer who created the app lives in Samarkand
The programmer who created this app lives in Samarkand

exercises.instructionUz: Ikki gapni which bilan bitta gapga birlaştiring (butun gapga işora).
exercises.explanationUz: Which oldingi butun gapga işora qiladi: …, which made everyone happy.
exercises.text: The update fixed all the problems, ___ made everyone happy.

exercises.instructionUz: Relative olmoşni taşlab ketiş mumkin bölgan gaplarni belgilang.
exercises.question: In which sentences can the relative pronoun be left out?
options: The app that she recommended is free.
The engineer who built it is famous.
The investor whom we met was kind.
The phone which broke was new.
The city where I live is quiet.
exercises.explanationUz: Olmoş töldiruvçi bölganda taşlanadi (she recommended it, we met him). Ega bölganda va where’da taşlab bölmaydi.
Ötmişdagi xayoliy şart: If + had + V3 (had known).
exercises.question: If I ___ about the flood, I would have moved my car.

exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe’llarni Third Conditional şaklida yozing.
exercises.explanationUz: If bölagi — had + V3 (had planted); natija — would have + V3 (would have stopped).
exercises.text: If the farmers ___ (plant) trees, the wind ___ (stop) the dust.

exercises.explanationUz: Ötmişdagi xato — should have + V3.
exercises.question: The river is polluted. The factory ___ its waste more carefully.

exercises.explanationUz: ega + could have + V3: It could have been much worse.

exercises.instructionUz: Inglizça gapni özbek tiliga tarjima qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: “Should have listened” — “quloq solişimiz kerak edi”.
exercises.source: We should have listened to the scientists.
accepted: Biz olimlarga quloq solişimiz kerak edi
Olimlarga quloq solişimiz kerak edi
Biz olimlarni tinglaşimiz kerak edi
Olimlarning gapiga quloq solişimiz kerak edi

exercises.explanationUz: Daryolar suğoriş uçun bunça köp işlatilmaganida, Orol dengizi bunça tez qurib qolmagan bölardi. — If the rivers hadn’t been used so much for irrigation, the Aral Sea wouldn’t have shrunk so quickly.
exercises.source: Daryolar suğoriş uçun bunça köp işlatilmaganida, Orol dengizi bunça tez qurib qolmagan bölardi.
accepted: If the rivers hadn’t been used so much for irrigation, the Aral Sea wouldn’t have shrunk so quickly.

exercises.explanationUz: Ob-havoni tekşirganimizda, çodirda dam olişga bormagan bölardik. — If we had checked the weather, we wouldn’t have gone camping.
exercises.source: Ob-havoni tekşirganimizda, çodirda dam olişga bormagan bölardik.
accepted: If we had checked the weather, we wouldn’t have gone camping.

exercises.explanationUz: If bölagida would işlatilmaydi: If they had listened …
exercises.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: If they would have listened, it wouldn’t have happened.
If they had listened, it wouldn’t have happened.
If they listened, it wouldn’t have happened.
If they had listened, it won’t have happened.

exercises.instructionUz: Özbekça gapni ingliz tiliga tarjima qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: “… sangiz edi, … bölardi” (ötmişda) — If you had …, … would have …
exercises.source: Agar menga aytganingizda, men yordam bergan bölardim.
accepted: If you had told me, I would have helped
If you had told me I would have helped
If you had told me, I would have helped you
If you’d told me, I’d have helped
I would have helped if you had told me

exercises.instructionUz: Böş joyga should have, shouldn’t have yoki could have ni yozing.
exercises.explanationUz: Qilmaslik kerak bölgan iş — shouldn’t have; foydalanilmagan imkoniyat — could have.
exercises.text: They ___ built houses so close to the river. We ___ taken the bus, but we decided to walk.

sortItems.text: You should have checked the weather.
We shouldn’t have left the window open.
We could have taken a taxi.
She could have won, but she fell.
If it had rained, the crops would have survived.
I would have called if I had known.

exercises.explanationUz: should have — xato; could have — imkoniyat bor edi; would have — Third Conditional natijasi.
Poyezd biz kelişimizdan OLDIN ketgan — Past Perfect: had left.
exercises.question: When we got to the platform, the train ___.

exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe’llarni Past Continuous yoki Past Simple şaklida yozing.
exercises.explanationUz: Davom etayotgan jarayon — was walking; uni uzgan qisqa voqea — started.
exercises.text: We ___ (walk) through the bazaar when it suddenly ___ (start) to rain.

exercises.explanationUz: Ötgan nuqtagaça qança davom etgani (for three hours) — had been waiting.
exercises.question: We ___ for three hours when the bus finally arrived.

exercises.explanationUz: ega + realised + ega + had + V3 …

exercises.instructionUz: Inglizça gapni özbek tiliga tarjima qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: “Had never seen” — “ilgari heç qaçon körmagan edim”.
exercises.source: I had never seen the desert before that trip.
accepted: Öşa safargaça men heç qaçon çölni körmagan edim
Öşa safardan oldin heç qaçon çölni körmagan edim
Men öşa safardan oldin çölni heç körmagan edim

exercises.explanationUz: Nihoyat Xivaga yetib kelganimizda, qoronğilaşayotgan edi. — It was getting dark when we finally reached Khiva.
exercises.source: Nihoyat Xivaga yetib kelganimizda, qoronğilaşayotgan edi.
accepted: It was getting dark when we finally reached Khiva.

exercises.explanationUz: Çamadonimni oçganimda, kimdir kamerani olib ketganini kördim. — When I opened my suitcase, I saw that someone had taken my camera.
exercises.source: Çamadonimni oçganimda, kimdir kamerani olib ketganini kördim.
accepted: When I opened my suitcase, I saw that someone had taken my camera.

exercises.instructionUz: Lucy hikoyasidagi voqealarni sodir bölgan tartibda joylaştiring.
exercises.question: Voqealar ketma-ketligi.
items: She spent the day in Shakhrisabz.
Gulsara’s son drove her to the bus station.
itemsShuffled: Gulsara’s son drove her to the bus station.
She spent the day in Shakhrisabz.
exercises.explanationUz: Matnda Past Perfect bilan berilgan voqealar (çipta olgan) hikoya boşlanişidan ham oldin bölgan.

exercises.instructionUz: By the time bilan töğri gapni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: By the time + Past Simple, … had + V3.
exercises.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: By the time we arrived, the museum closed already.
By the time we had arrived, the museum closes.
By the time we arrived, the museum had closed.
By the time we arrive, the museum had closed.

exercises.instructionUz: Özbekça gapni ingliz tiliga tarjima qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: “… ayotganimda” — while + Past Continuous; asosiy voqea — Past Simple.
exercises.source: Men surat olayotganimda, kimdir sumkamni ögirlab ketdi.
accepted: While I was taking photos, someone stole my bag
While I was taking pictures, someone stole my bag
When I was taking photos, someone stole my bag
Someone stole my bag while I was taking photos
While I was taking a photo, someone stole my bag

exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe’lni Past Perfect Continuous şaklida yozing.
exercises.explanationUz: Sabab — ötgan nuqtagaça davom etgan jarayon: had been driving.
exercises.text: He was exhausted because he ___ (drive) all night.

exercises.explanationUz: Afford’dan keyin to + fe’l.
exercises.question: We can’t afford ___ a new fridge right now.

exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe’lni gerund (-ing) yoki infinitive (to) şaklida yozing.
exercises.explanationUz: avoid + -ing (using); decide + to (to save).
exercises.text: I try to avoid ___ (use) my credit card. This year we decided ___ (save) for a holiday.

exercises.explanationUz: Odatni taşlaş — stop + -ing: stopped buying.
exercises.question: To save money, I ___ lunch in cafés and started cooking at home.

exercises.explanationUz: Old qöşimçadan keyin -ing: good at saving.
exercises.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: She is good at save money.
She is good at to save money.
She is good at saving money.
She is good for saving money at.

exercises.explanationUz: It’s worth + -ing: It’s worth comparing prices online.
Har dam oliş kuni restoranda ovqatlanişga qurbimiz yetmaydi. — We can’t afford to eat out every weekend.
exercises.source: Har dam oliş kuni restoranda ovqatlanişga qurbimiz yetmaydi.
accepted: We can’t afford to eat out every weekend.

exercises.explanationUz: Otam menga jamğarma hisobi oçişni taklif qildi. — My father suggested opening a savings account for me.
exercises.source: Otam menga jamğarma hisobi oçişni taklif qildi.
accepted: My father suggested opening a savings account for me.

exercises.instructionUz: Inglizça gapni özbek tiliga tarjima qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: “Managed to” — “uddasidan çiqdi / … ğa erişdi”.
exercises.source: She managed to pay off her debt in two years.
accepted: U ikki yilda qarzini uzişga erişdi
U qarzini ikki yilda uzib bitirdi
U ikki yil içida qarzini tölab bölişga erişdi
U qarzini ikki yilda tölab bitirişning uddasidan çiqdi

exercises.instructionUz: Fe’llarni keyin keladigan şakl böyiça saralang.
exercises.explanationUz: avoid / suggest / enjoy + -ing; afford / refuse / manage + to.

exercises.instructionUz: Remember’dan keyin to yoki -ing ni tanlab yozing.
exercises.explanationUz: Bajariş kerak bölgan iş — remember to pay; ötmişdagi xotira — remember paying.
exercises.text: Please remember ___ (pay) the electricity bill tomorrow. I clearly remember ___ (pay) it last month.

exercises.instructionUz: Özbekça gapni ingliz tiliga tarjima qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: “… ni taklif qildi” — suggested + -ing.
exercises.source: Bankir kiçikroq kredit olişni taklif qildi.
accepted: The banker suggested taking a smaller loan
The banker suggested taking out a smaller loan
The bank manager suggested taking a smaller loan
The banker suggested getting a smaller loan

exercises.explanationUz: Hozirgi holat haqida istak — wish + Past Simple: had.
exercises.question: I wish I ___ a bigger flat. Ours is too small for five people.

exercises.explanationUz: Ötmiş — wish + had + V3: hadn’t spent.
exercises.question: I’m so tired today. I wish I ___ so long on my phone last night.

exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe’llarni wish dan keyingi töğri şaklda yozing.
exercises.explanationUz: Hozir — knew; ötmiş — had gone.
exercises.text: I wish I ___ (know) how to help him now. I wish I ___ ___ (go) to the meeting yesterday.

exercises.explanationUz: Boşqa odamning xatti-harakati — wish + would: would stop.
exercises.question: I wish my brother ___ playing games all night.

exercises.explanationUz: If only + ega + had + V3: If only I had listened to her.
Bobom va buvimni yöqlab boriş uçun köproq vaqtim bölsa edi. — I wish I had more time to visit my grandparents.
exercises.source: Bobom va buvimni yöqlab boriş uçun köproq vaqtim bölsa edi.
accepted: I wish I had more time to visit my grandparents.

exercises.explanationUz: Qaniydi, talabaligimda köngilli bölganimda! — If only I had volunteered when I was a student!
exercises.source: Qaniydi, talabaligimda köngilli bölganimda!
accepted: If only I had volunteered when I was a student!

exercises.instructionUz: Inglizça gapni özbek tiliga tarjima qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: “I wish I hadn’t said that” — “Qaniydi, buni aytmaganimda” / “Buni aytganimdan afsusdaman”.
exercises.source: I wish I hadn’t said that.
accepted: Qaniydi, buni aytmaganimda
Buni aytganimdan afsusdaman
Qaniydi, men buni aytmagan bölsam
Kaşki buni aytmagan bölsam

exercises.instructionUz: Wish yoki hope dan töğrisini tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Ertangi kun — real ehtimol: hope.
exercises.question: I ___ the weather is good for the charity run tomorrow.

exercises.instructionUz: Özbekça gapni ingliz tiliga tarjima qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: “Qaniydi, … olsam” — I wish I could …
exercises.source: Qaniydi, ularga köproq yordam bera olsam.
accepted: I wish I could help them more
If only I could help them more
I wish I were able to help them more

exercises.instructionUz: Har böşliq uçun mos şaklni tanlang.
exercises.text: I wish I ___ more time for my family now. I wish I ___ that job in another city last year. And I wish my boss ___ calling me at weekends!
exercises.explanationUz: Hozir — had; ötmiş — hadn’t taken; boşqa odamning odati — would stop.
Kelajakdagi aniq paytda davom etayotgan iş — will be + V-ing.
exercises.question: This time tomorrow I ___ on a beach in Antalya.

exercises.instructionUz: By + vaqt bilan mos şaklni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Vaqtgaça tugagan iş — will have + V3.
exercises.question: By the end of this course, you ___ more than 500 new words.

exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe’llarni Future Continuous yoki Future Perfect şaklida yozing.
exercises.explanationUz: Soat 8 da davom etayotgan iş — will be driving; juma kunigaça tugagan — will have finished.
exercises.text: At 8 a.m. I ___ ___ (drive) to work. By Friday we ___ ___ ___ (finish) the project.

exercises.explanationUz: By + vaqt + ega + will have + V3.

exercises.instructionUz: Inglizça gapni özbek tiliga tarjima qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: “We’ll be having dinner” — “keçki ovqat qilayotgan bölamiz”.
exercises.source: Don’t call at seven — we’ll be having dinner.
accepted: Soat yettida qöngiroq qilmang — keçki ovqat qilayotgan bölamiz
Yettida qöngiroq qilmang, keçki ovqat qilayotgan bölamiz
Soat yettida qöngiroq qilmang, biz keçki ovqatlanayotgan bölamiz

exercises.explanationUz: Kelasi yil aynan şu paytda Seulda öqiyotgan bölaman. — This time next year I will be studying in Seoul.
exercises.source: Kelasi yil aynan şu paytda Seulda öqiyotgan bölaman.
accepted: This time next year I will be studying in Seoul.

exercises.explanationUz: Oy oxirigaça kreditni tölab bölgan bölamiz. — By the end of the month we will have paid off the loan.
exercises.source: Oy oxirigaça kreditni tölab bölgan bölamiz.
accepted: By the end of the month we will have paid off the loan.

sortItems.text: Next week we’ll be moving house.
By midnight I’ll have finished the essay.
By 2030 they’ll have built the metro.

exercises.explanationUz: Jarayon — will be + V-ing; natija (by bilan) — will have + V3.
Rejani söraş — Will you be + V-ing?
exercises.question: You want to borrow your colleague’s car tonight. Which question is the most polite?
options: Will you use your car tonight?
Will you be using your car tonight?
Do you use your car tonight?
Are you use your car tonight?

exercises.instructionUz: Özbekça gapni ingliz tiliga tarjima qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: “… gaça … bölgan bölaman” — will have + V3.
exercises.source: Yil oxirigaça men kitobni yozib bölgan bölaman.
accepted: By the end of the year I will have finished writing the book
By the end of the year I will have written the book
I will have written the book by the end of the year
By the end of the year, I will have finished the book
By the end of the year I’ll have written the book

exercises.explanationUz: Kelajak nuqtasigaça qança davom etgan — will have been + V-ing.
exercises.question: In September my parents ___ in this house for thirty years.

exercises.instructionUz: Matn asosida savolga töğri javobni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Birinçi paragraf: menejer zavod bilan tekşirmasdan “no problem” deb javob bergan.
exercises.question: What was the sales manager’s first mistake?

exercises.question: “I am busy,” Malika said. → Malika said that she ___ busy.

exploit — ekspluatatsiya qilmoq, nohaq foydalanmoq; integrity — halollik, vijdonlilik; whistleblower — qonunbuzarlik haqida xabar beruvçi
greenwashing — soxta “yaşil” reklama; stakeholder — manfaatdor tomon; arguably — aytiş mumkinki, ehtimol
tend to — odatda … moyil bölmoq; loophole — qonundagi böşliq; reputation — obröy, nom
breakthrough — kaşfiyot, keskin yutuq; hypothesis — gipoteza, faraz; peer review — mutaxassislar taqrizi
replicate — takrorlab tasdiqlamoq; funding — moliyalaştiriş; misinformation — notöğri ma’lumot
consensus — umumiy fikr, kelişuv; sceptical — şubhali, işonmaydigan; drought-resistant — qurğoqçilikka çidamli
yield — hosil (miqdori); outreach — jamoatçilik bilan iş; evidence-based — dalilga asoslangan
nevertheless — şunga qaramay; furthermore — bundan taşqari; whereas — holbuki, … esa
consequently — natijada, şu sababli; thesis statement — asosiy da’vo (tezis); counterargument — qarşi dalil
cite — iqtibos keltirmoq, manbaga tayanmoq; plagiarism — plagiat, köçirmaçilik; coherent — izçil, mantiqli
paraphrase — öz sözlari bilan qayta ifodalamoq; implication — oqibat, xulosa; draft — qoralama
Never + yordamçi (have) + ega (I) + V3.
exercises.question: Never ___ such a weak argument in a published article.

exercises.explanationUz: Rarely + do + ega + fe’l; Not only + did + ega + fe’l.
exercises.text: Rarely ___ people check who funded a study. Not only ___ the report ignore key data, but it also misquoted experts.

exercises.instructionUz: No sooner bilan töğri gapni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: No sooner had + ega + V3 + than …
exercises.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: No sooner the video was posted than it went viral.
No sooner had the video been posted than it went viral.
No sooner had the video been posted when it went viral.
No sooner did the video posted than it went viral.

exercises.explanationUz: Under no circumstances + should + ega + fe’l …

exercises.instructionUz: Inglizça gapni özbek tiliga tarjima qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: “Not only … but also …” — “nafaqat …, balki … ham”.
exercises.source: Not only is the claim unfounded, but it is also harmful.
accepted: Bu da’vo nafaqat asossiz, balki zararli ham
Da’vo nafaqat asossiz, balki zararli hamdir
Bu fikr nafaqat asossiz, balki zararli ham

exercises.explanationUz: Kompaniya heç qaçon bunday omma tanqidiga uçramagan edi. — Never before had the company faced such public criticism.
exercises.source: Kompaniya heç qaçon bunday omma tanqidiga uçramagan edi.
accepted: Never before had the company faced such public criticism.

exercises.explanationUz: Maqola mutaxassis sözlarini nafaqat buzib keltirdi, balki eski suratdan ham foydalandi. — Not only did the article misquote the expert, but it also used an old photo.
exercises.source: Maqola mutaxassis sözlarini nafaqat buzib keltirdi, balki eski suratdan ham foydalandi.
accepted: Not only did the article misquote the expert, but it also used an old photo.

exercises.instructionUz: Only when bilan inversion qaysi bölakda bölişini aniqlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Inversion asosiy gapda: … did we notice.
exercises.question: Only when we read the original paper ___ the mistake.

exercises.instructionUz: Özbekça gapni ingliz tiliga inversion bilan tarjima qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: “Kamdan-kam hollarda … miz” — Rarely / Seldom + do + ega + fe’l.
exercises.source: Biz kamdan-kam hollarda öz qaraşlarimizga şubha bilan qaraymiz.
accepted: Rarely do we question our own views
Seldom do we question our own views
Rarely do we question our own opinions
Seldom do we question our own opinions
Rarely do we doubt our own views

exercises.explanationUz: Yordamçi fe’l yöq — did qöşiladi: Little did she know.
exercises.text: Little ___ she know that the photo had been edited.

exercises.question: Which sentences are correct?
options: Rarely do we see such honesty.
Never I have been so surprised.
Not only he wrote the book, but he also designed the cover.
Under no circumstances should the door be left open.
exercises.explanationUz: “Never I have” — xato (have I); “Not only he wrote” — xato (did he write).

exercises.instructionUz: Ta’kidli gapni töğri tuzilgan variantini tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: It + was + X + who (odam haqida).
exercises.question: It was the young designers ___ suggested the new product.

exercises.explanationUz: What + ega + fe’l + is …; harakat — What … did was …
exercises.text: ___ employers value most is reliability. What the city ___ was build a training centre.

exercises.instructionUz: Bir xil ma’noli ta’kidli gapni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Ta’kid ega ustida: It is low pay that …
exercises.question: Low pay makes young doctors leave. → ___
options: It is low pay that makes young doctors leave.
It is low pay what makes young doctors leave.
What is low pay makes young doctors leave.
It makes low pay young doctors leave.

exercises.explanationUz: All + ega + fe’l + is + …: All I need is time.

exercises.instructionUz: Inglizça gapni özbek tiliga tarjima qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: “What surprised me was …” — “Meni hayron qoldirgan narsa — …”.
exercises.source: What surprised me was the number of applicants.
accepted: Meni hayron qoldirgan narsa — nomzodlar soni edi
Meni hayron qoldirgan narsa nomzodlar soni edi
Meni ajablantirgan narsa — arizaçilar soni edi
Meni hayratlantirgani nomzodlar soni böldi

exercises.explanationUz: Yoşlarni iste’dod yetişmasligi emas, aynan imkoniyatlar yöqligi orqaga tortadi. — It is not a lack of talent that holds young people back, but a lack of opportunities.
exercises.source: Yoşlarni iste’dod yetişmasligi emas, aynan imkoniyatlar yöqligi orqaga tortadi.
accepted: It is not a lack of talent that holds young people back, but a lack of opportunities.

exercises.explanationUz: Köp iş beruvçilar izlaydigan narsa — tez örganiş qobiliyati. — What most employers look for is the ability to learn quickly.
exercises.source: Köp iş beruvçilar izlaydigan narsa — tez örganiş qobiliyati.
accepted: What most employers look for is the ability to learn quickly.

exercises.explanationUz: Sabab — The reason why … is that …
exercises.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: The reason why he resigned is because the stress.
The reason why he resigned is that the workload was too heavy.
The reason why he resigned it was the workload.
Why he resigned the reason is the workload.

exercises.instructionUz: Özbekça gapni ingliz tiliga cleft gap bilan tarjima qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: “Aynan … edi” — It was … that …
exercises.source: Kompaniyani aynan yangi rahbar qutqardi.
accepted: It was the new manager who saved the company
It was the new manager that saved the company
It was the new director who saved the company
It was the new boss who saved the company
It was the new leader who saved the company

exercises.explanationUz: It was + vaqt + that …: It was in 2017 that …
exercises.text: It ___ in 2017 ___ the reform began.

exercises.instructionUz: Har böşliq uçun mos şaklni tanlang.
exercises.text: ___ worries me is the cost. It was my teacher ___ encouraged me. The reason why I left is ___ the pay was low.
exercises.explanationUz: What … is; It was + odam + who; The reason why … is that.
Ötmişdagi voqea — is believed to have + V3.
exercises.question: The caravanserai is believed ___ in the 11th century.

exercises.explanationUz: It + is + V3 + that …; ega + is expected + to + fe’l.
exercises.text: It ___ estimated that trade will double. The project is ___ to create new jobs.

exercises.explanationUz: It is said that he owns … = He is said to own …
exercises.question: It is said that the businessman owns five factories. → The businessman ___
options: is said to own five factories.
is said to have owned five factories now.

exercises.instructionUz: Inglizça gapni özbek tiliga tarjima qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: “Is expected to” — “… kutilmoqda”.
exercises.source: Inflation is expected to fall next year.
accepted: Kelasi yili inflyatsiya pasayişi kutilmoqda
Inflyatsiya kelasi yili pasayişi kutilmoqda
Kelgusi yili inflyatsiya tuşişi kutilmoqda
Kelasi yil inflyatsiya kamayişi kutilmoqda

exercises.explanationUz: There are thought to be …
exercises.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: There are thought to be many problems with the plan.
There is thought being many problems with the plan.
It is thought to be many problems with the plan.
There are thought that many problems are with the plan.

exercises.explanationUz: Ipak yöli Xitoyni Örta yer dengizi bilan boğlagan, deb keng ta’kidlanadi. — It is widely believed that the Silk Road connected China with the Mediterranean.
exercises.source: Ipak yöli Xitoyni Örta yer dengizi bilan boğlagan, deb keng ta’kidlanadi.
accepted: It is widely believed that the Silk Road connected China with the Mediterranean.

exercises.explanationUz: Samarqand Markaziy Osiyodagi eng qadimiy şaharlardan biri hisoblanadi. — Samarkand is thought to be one of the oldest cities in Central Asia.
exercises.source: Samarqand Markaziy Osiyodagi eng qadimiy şaharlardan biri hisoblanadi.
accepted: Samarkand is thought to be one of the oldest cities in Central Asia.

exercises.explanationUz: ega + is + V3 + to have + V3 …

exercises.instructionUz: Özbekça gapni ingliz tiliga impersonal passive bilan tarjima qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: “… deb hisoblanadi” — is thought / believed to be.
exercises.source: Bu bozor viloyatdagi eng qadimiy bozor deb hisoblanadi.
accepted: This bazaar is thought to be the oldest in the region
This bazaar is believed to be the oldest in the region
This market is thought to be the oldest in the region
This bazaar is considered to be the oldest in the region
It is believed that this bazaar is the oldest in the region
This bazaar is thought to be the oldest bazaar in the region

exercises.explanationUz: to be + V-ing: is reported to be negotiating.
exercises.text: The government is reported to ___ ___ (negotiate) a new trade agreement.

sortItems.text: He is said to live in Dubai.
The firm is thought to employ 300 people.
He is said to have made a fortune.
The tower is believed to have been built in 1127.

exercises.explanationUz: Hozirgi holat — to + fe’l; oldinroq voqea — to have + V3.

exercises.instructionUz: Ötmiş şart → hozirgi natija uçun mos şaklni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Hozirgi natija (now) — would + fe’l.
exercises.question: If I had grown up in London, my English ___ perfect now.

exercises.instructionUz: Hozirgi xususiyat → ötmişdagi natija uçun mos şaklni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Ötmişdagi natija — would have + V3.
exercises.question: If Kamol weren’t so forgetful, he ___ his passport at home yesterday.

exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe’llarni aralaş şart gap şaklida yozing.
exercises.explanationUz: Ötmiş şart — had + V3 (hadn’t moved); hozirgi natija — would + fe’l (would speak).
exercises.text: If my family ___ (not / move) to Kazan, I ___ (speak) Uzbek at home now.

exercises.instructionUz: Inglizça gapni özbek tiliga tarjima qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: Hozirgi xususiyat → ötmiş natija: “… bölmaganida, … magan bölardi”.
exercises.source: If she weren’t so talented, she wouldn’t have won the competition.
accepted: U bunça iste’dodli bölmaganida, tanlovda ğolib bölmagan bölardi
Agar u bunça iste’dodli bölmasa edi, tanlovda yutmagan bölardi
U bunça qobiliyatli bölmaganida, musobaqada ğolib çiqmagan bölardi

exercises.explanationUz: Ötmiş şart (hadn’t missed) + hozirgi natija (would be … now).
exercises.question: Which sentence is a mixed conditional?
options: If it rains, we’ll stay at home.
If I had known, I would have come.
If we hadn’t missed the flight, we would be in Seoul now.
If I were you, I would apologise.

exercises.explanationUz: Bobom va buvim Farğonadan ketmaganlarida, ehtimol, men hozir öşa yerda yaşagan bölardim. — If my grandparents hadn’t left Fergana, I would probably live there now.
exercises.source: Bobom va buvim Farğonadan ketmaganlarida, ehtimol, men hozir öşa yerda yaşagan bölardim.
accepted: If my grandparents hadn’t left Fergana, I would probably live there now.

exercises.explanationUz: U ikki tilli bölmaganida, elçixonadagi işga qabul qilinmagan bölardi. — If she weren’t bilingual, she wouldn’t have got the job at the embassy.
exercises.source: U ikki tilli bölmaganida, elçixonadagi işga qabul qilinmagan bölardi.
accepted: If she weren’t bilingual, she wouldn’t have got the job at the embassy.

exercises.explanationUz: Had + ega + V3, … would + fe’l.

exercises.instructionUz: Özbekça gapni ingliz tiliga aralaş şart gap bilan tarjima qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: Ötmiş şart (olmaganimda) + hozirgi natija (… yotgan bölardim) — If I hadn’t …, I would be …
exercises.source: Agar öşa grantni olmaganimda, hozir Toşkentda işlayotgan bölardim.
accepted: If I hadn’t got that grant, I would be working in Tashkent now
If I hadn't got that grant, I would be working in Tashkent now
If I had not received that grant, I would be working in Tashkent now
If I hadn’t received that grant, I would be working in Tashkent now
If I hadn’t won that grant, I would be working in Tashkent now

exercises.instructionUz: Böş joyga could yoki would bilan mos şaklni yozing.
exercises.explanationUz: Imkoniyat — could + be + V-ing.
exercises.text: If you had accepted the offer, you ___ be living in Dubai now.

sortItems.text: If I had known, I would have come.
If she had left earlier, she would have caught the bus.
If I had saved, I would be rich now.
If they hadn’t moved, they would live near us today.
If he weren’t so lazy, he would have finished.
If I spoke French, I would have understood the film.

exercises.explanationUz: Natijadagi vaqtga qarang: would have + V3 (ötmiş) yoki would + fe’l (hozir).
“may indicate” — dalil hali kuçsiz bölganda eng mos.
exercises.question: One small survey: “The results ___ that customers prefer refillable bottles.”

exercises.instructionUz: Böş joylarni appear, tend yoki arguably bilan töldiring.
exercises.explanationUz: appear to + fe’l; tend to + fe’l; arguably — ravişdoş.
exercises.text: Large firms ___ to recover from scandals more quickly. The new rules ___ to have reduced fraud. This is ___ the best solution so far.

exercises.instructionUz: Gapni akademik uslubga mos ravişda yumşating.
exercises.explanationUz: It could be argued that … — rasmiy va ehtiyotkor.
exercises.question: “The law is useless.” → Which is the most appropriate in an academic essay?
options: It could be argued that the law has had limited effect.
Everybody knows the law is useless.

exercises.explanationUz: to some extent — “ma’lum darajada”.
exercises.text: To some ___, both sides are responsible for the conflict.

exercises.instructionUz: Inglizça gapni özbek tiliga tarjima qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: “Tend to” — “… ga moyil”, “odatda …”.
exercises.source: Young consumers tend to choose brands with clear values.
accepted: Yoş xaridorlar aniq qadriyatlarga ega brendlarni tanlaşga moyil
Yoş iste’molçilar odatda aniq qadriyatli brendlarni tanlaydi
Yoş xaridorlar odatda aniq qadriyatlari bor brendlarni tanlaydi

exercises.explanationUz: Raqamlar past maoş va xodimlar tez almaşişi örtasida boğliqlik borligini körsatayotganga öxşaydi. — The figures appear to show a link between low wages and high staff turnover.
exercises.source: Raqamlar past maoş va xodimlar tez almaşişi örtasida boğliqlik borligini körsatayotganga öxşaydi.
accepted: The figures appear to show a link between low wages and high staff turnover.

exercises.explanationUz: Soxta yaşil reklamani yolğonning bir turi deb aytiş mumkin. — It could be argued that greenwashing is a form of lying.
exercises.source: Soxta yaşil reklamani yolğonning bir turi deb aytiş mumkin.
accepted: It could be argued that greenwashing is a form of lying.

exercises.explanationUz: Aniq tarixiy faktga hedge kerak emas; bu yerda uç marta ehtiyotkorlik matnni noaniq qiladi.
exercises.question: Which sentence uses too much hedging?
options: The company closed its factory in 2019.
It might possibly perhaps be the case that the company may have closed its factory in 2019.
Sales appear to have fallen since 2019.
This suggests that customers lost trust.

exercises.explanationUz: It + would + appear + that …

exercises.instructionUz: Özbekça gapni ingliz tiliga ehtiyotkor ifoda bilan tarjima qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: “… ga öxşaydi” — seem / appear to + fe’l.
exercises.source: Kompaniya xatosidan saboq olganga öxşaydi.
accepted: The company seems to have learned from its mistake
The company appears to have learned from its mistake
The company seems to have learnt from its mistake
The company appears to have learnt from its mistake
It seems that the company has learned from its mistake

exercises.instructionUz: Fe’llarni işonç darajasi böyiça — eng kuçlidan eng ehtiyotkorgaça tartiblang.
exercises.question: Eng kuçli → eng ehtiyotkor.
exercises.explanationUz: proves (isbotlaydi) → shows (körsatadi) → suggests (taxmin qilişga asos beradi) → may indicate (körsatişi mumkin).

exercises.instructionUz: Passiv ma’no uçun töğri şaklni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Tadqiqot moliyalaştirilgan (passiv) → Funded.
exercises.question: ___ by the government, the research lasted five years.

exercises.instructionUz: Avval tugagan harakat uçun töğri şaklni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Avval ma’lumot yiğildi, keyin tahlil qilindi → Having collected.
exercises.question: ___ the data, the team began the analysis.

exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe’lning töğri participle şaklini yozing.
exercises.explanationUz: Faol + bir vaqtda → -ing; passiv → V3.
exercises.text: ___ (live) near the Aral Sea, Bekzod saw the changes himself. ___ (write) in Uzbek and Karakalpak, the leaflet reached many families.

exercises.instructionUz: Inglizça gapni özbek tiliga tarjima qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: Published … — passiv: “… da çop etilgan”.
exercises.source: Published in 2021, the study changed the debate.
accepted: 2021-yilda çop etilgan tadqiqot munozarani özgartirdi
2021-yilda nashr etilgan tadqiqot bahsni özgartirdi
2021-yilda çop etilgan tadqiqot bahsni özgartirdi
2021-yilda nashr etilgan tadqiqot munozarani özgartirdi

exercises.explanationUz: -ing — faol/bir vaqtda; V3 — passiv; having + V3 — avval tugagan.
Dehqon oilasida ösgani uçun Dilnoza yangi uruğlar nega muhimligini tuşunardi. — Having grown up in a farming family, Dilnoza understood why the new seeds mattered.
exercises.source: Dehqon oilasida ösgani uçun Dilnoza yangi uruğlar nega muhimligini tuşunardi.
accepted: Having grown up in a farming family, Dilnoza understood why the new seeds mattered.

exercises.explanationUz: Uç viloyatda sinalgan yangi buğdoy kamroq suv bilan köproq hosil berdi. — Tested in three regions, the new wheat produced higher yields with less water.
exercises.source: Uç viloyatda sinalgan yangi buğdoy kamroq suv bilan köproq hosil berdi.
accepted: Tested in three regions, the new wheat produced higher yields with less water.

exercises.explanationUz: “Looking at the results” — natijaga qaraydigan odam, telefon emas. Ega mos kelmagan.
exercises.question: Which sentence is incorrect?
options: Looking at the results, the scientist smiled.
Looking at the results, my phone rang.
Looking at the results, we noticed an error.
Looking at the results, she called her colleague.

exercises.explanationUz: Not + participle … , asosiy gap.

exercises.instructionUz: Gapni participle clause bilan ingliz tiliga tarjima qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: “… gaç / … gandan söng” → Having + V3.
exercises.source: Hisobotni öqib çiqqandan söng, vazir dasturni qöllab-quvvatladi.
accepted: Having read the report, the minister supported the programme
Having read the report, the minister supported the program
Having read the report the minister supported the programme

exercises.instructionUz: Ergaş gapni participle clause bilan almaştiring.
exercises.explanationUz: Because she didn’t have … → Not having …
exercises.question: Because she didn’t have enough data, she postponed the article. →
options: Not having enough data, she postponed the article.
Having not enough data, she postponed the article.
Not had enough data, she postponed the article.
Didn’t having enough data, she postponed the article.

exercises.explanationUz: Bepul, lekin kam talaba → kutilmagan natija → Nevertheless.
exercises.question: The course was free. ___, very few students joined.

exercises.explanationUz: Narx oşdi → talab kamaydi: sabab-natija → consequently.
exercises.question: Fees doubled; ___, the number of applicants fell.
Akademik esse tuzilmasi
exercises.explanationUz: Kiriş va tezis → dalillar → qarşi dalil va javob → xulosa.
decide → decision; grow → growth; fail → failure.
exercises.text: The ___ (decide) to build a new campus led to rapid ___ (grow). However, the ___ (fail) of the transport plan caused problems.

exercises.explanationUz: Furthermore, + töliq gap.
Kurs bepul edi. Şunga qaramay, kam talaba yozildi. — The course was free. Nevertheless, few students signed up.
exercises.source: Kurs bepul edi. Şunga qaramay, kam talaba yozildi.
accepted: The course was free. Nevertheless, few students signed up.

exercises.explanationUz: Ayrim universitetlar ingliz tilida öqitadi, boşqalari esa özbek yoki rus tilida. — Some universities teach in English, whereas others use Uzbek or Russian.
exercises.source: Ayrim universitetlar ingliz tilida öqitadi, boşqalari esa özbek yoki rus tilida.
accepted: Some universities teach in English, whereas others use Uzbek or Russian.

exercises.explanationUz: Qöşiş: moreover, furthermore; qarama-qarşilik: however, whereas; natija: therefore, consequently.

exercises.instructionUz: Qaysi gapda tinish belgisi va marker töğri işlatilgan?
exercises.explanationUz: However, moreover, therefore ikki gapni faqat vergul bilan ulay olmaydi; whereas esa bitta gap ichida ikki qismni boğlaydi.
exercises.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: Rents in Tashkent are high, however salaries are low.
Rents in Tashkent are high, whereas salaries are low.
Rents in Tashkent are high, moreover salaries are low.
Rents in Tashkent are high, therefore salaries low.

exercises.instructionUz: Gapni nominalisation bilan qayta yozilgan eng yaxşi variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: “Prices increased → the increase in prices”; “people bought less → a fall in demand”.
exercises.question: Because prices increased, people bought less. →
options: The increase in prices led to a fall in demand.
The increasing prices they bought less.
Prices increase, so the buying is less.
Because of increase, people less buying.

exercises.instructionUz: Gapni ingliz tiliga tarjima qiling (ot şaklidan foydalaning).
exercises.explanationUz: “… ning köpayişi” — the growth of …
exercises.source: Onlayn kurslarning köpayişi ta’limni özgartirdi.
accepted: The growth of online courses has changed education
The growth of online courses changed education
The rise of online courses has changed education
The increase in online courses has changed education

exercises.explanationUz: Birinçi paragraf: aql-zakovat notöğri ma’lumotdan deyarli himoya qilmaydi.
exercises.question: What is the writer’s main point in the first paragraph?
options: Only poorly educated people believe false news
Intelligence does not reliably protect people from misinformation
